clips.title: The story
paras: Prospector Stormpike is a blunt, short-tempered dwarf stationed within the Library of the Hall of Explorers in Ironforge. A member of the renowned Stormpike clan, he oversees logistical support for distant archaeological digs and lends his sharp intellect to deciphering coded missives.

Tucked away amid the towering bookshelves of the Hall of Explorers, Prospector Stormpike coordinates excavation efforts across Khaz Modan and beyond. Despite his gruff demeanor and impatience with idle chatter, he is deeply dedicated to uncovering dwarven history, keeping distant sites supplied with essentials like blasting powder. Beneath his rough exterior lies a keen analytical mind skilled at breaking intricate ciphers, making him an unexpected asset to Alliance scouts dealing with clandestine threats.
